predeclaration.evaluation: All 28 B0 backgrounds, reference=agent, k=1, strict moving-message clear, rt, one worker; f0 mirror included. Existing benchmark gates unchanged.
predeclaration.fake_target: Same public scores restricted to living other seats minus the known ally; require a known ally.
predeclaration.hypothesis: Risk-gated ordinary false claims might rescue a wolf targeted by the public default; not assumed stronger.

profiles.only_ally_public_target: Same, only if the public default target is our known wolf ally.
profiles.only_me_public_target: Same, only if the public default target equals our seat.
profiles.proactive_all: Day 1 before any public seer claim, any wolf: broad proactive control.

predeclaration.public_target: B0 public suspicion on an explicit fields-only villager View, private=False, all living seats including self, low-seat ties; no private evidence, allies, checks or DMs.
predeclaration.scope: Development and replication are exploratory local scripted tables, not heldout/live strength. No model calls.
predeclaration.selection: Exactly one replication: max overall seat delta among integrity-clean positive seat+wolf deltas; otherwise max seat delta diagnostic. Ties: only_me, only_ally, proactive_all. No edits/tuning after results.
predeclaration.template: I am the Seer. Player{target} is a WOLF. Everyone vote Player{target} today.
predeclaration.topic: counter means existing guarded wolf-claim dedup slot, NOT that there was an accuser

validation.test_environment: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, ARENA_RECORD=0, ARENA_STATE=0, ARENA_SUMMARY=0, ARENA_TC_WATCHDOG=0
validation.compressed_log_integrity: gzip -t passed on manifest.json.gz, development.jsonl.gz and replication.jsonl.gz
validation.operational_note: An initial pytest launch was stopped during slow imports; two import-only diagnostic processes were also stopped. The completed test run had zero failed tests. No periodic faulthandler was used. No game runs were stopped or discarded.

interpretation.decision: No demonstrated stronger-than-B0 candidate; do not promote. The selected closest diagnostic shows a small positive replication point estimate, but fails both unchanged significant-primary-gain and substantial-primary-gain gates.
interpretation.comparisons: Single controlled seat (k=1), all variants intrinsically wolf-only; other six seats including the ally remain fixed background policies. Reference and f0 rerun on every scenario. Nonwolf full synthetic traces are byte-equivalent before hashing. No village-only behavioral change or two-wolf team replacement.
interpretation.sample_unit: One paired synthetic deal per seed/background/index; 2800 development and 5600 replication scenarios, not 30800 independent simulations. Three development candidates share reference deals; no pooled post-selection confirmation claim.
interpretation.mechanism: Ally gating reduced day-1 ally eliminations 123 to 87 in development and 302 to 236 in replication, but development final wolf wins stayed 551/782. Broad proactive control reduced day-1 wolf eliminations 210 to 137 yet LOST 33 final wins, showing that early rescue is not sufficient.
interpretation.limitations: Scripted opponents only, rt timing only, development seeds only; broad proactive control has substantial negative backgrounds. Replication conservative 95% delta CI still spans zero. No model/live/heldout evidence and no confirmation calls authorized here.

scope: exploratory scripted development/replication; no heldouts/model calls/deployment; parent confirmation only if positive
